hero.title: Rome, planned with the same discipline.
hero.body: No archive here yet — every stop is web-researched and marked as such until it has been walked and shot.

dayTemplates.purpose: Centro Storico first — the Pantheon, the piazzas, the city at street level.
One demanding anchor — the Vatican Museums — then the basilica and the river.

alt.purpose: The city without the queues — neighborhoods first.

dayTemplates.purpose: A gentler middle day — gardens, terraces, the Aventine keyhole.
The icons at golden hour — Trevi late, the climb to the Pincio.
The Colosseum early, then the Forum at ease.

alt.purpose: The slow side of the river — Trastevere, no museum required.

dayTemplates.purpose: A full day at Ostia Antica — the ancient port, whole and quiet.

alt.purpose: A personality day — Testaccio: the market, the Aventine, no monuments.

dayTemplates.purpose: No checklist. A buffer for weather, favourites and long caffès.
